title: @Autowired versus @Resource
context: What is the difference between @Autowired and @Resource?

source.title: JavaGuide (Snailclimb): Spring knowledge and questions
source.note: Translated and condensed into English; see content/sources/javaguide/NOTICE.md.

answer: `@Autowired` is Spring's annotation. It matches by type first, and if several beans match, it uses `@Qualifier` or the parameter name. It can be required or optional. `@Resource` comes from JSR-250. It matches by name first, falling back to type when no name matches. Use @Autowired in Spring code, with constructor injection. Use @Resource when you need name-based lookup or code that must stay portable to other containers.

points.title: Matching order
points.why: Autowired matches type first. Resource matches the name first.

points.title: Origin
points.why: Autowired is Spring-specific. Resource is standard Java (JSR-250).
